proof_rules: For 0<=D_i<=C_i and affine D dependence, D_i*L_i(C)>=C_i*min_coeff_part(L_i,0).
For q=e+t, 0<=t<=n-e, an affine q slope P_++P_- gives L(C,q)>=L(C,e)+(n-e)P_-.
Every retained-mark branch differs from its zero-retention branch coefficientwise nonnegatively.
scope_guard: This independently verifies the sufficient reduction to two q-free targets. It does not prove either target nonnegative.
